answer: The whisper schedule is applied in hollow and walnut reveals each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2405 identities would post 1914 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
